Countryside streamer (synthetic land): 64 m deterministic world cells around the camera replace the per-tile flora draw that popped at the 350 m near-tile edge and the 140 m hard pool cut; tile colliders use the same placement

No pop: full mesh to an impostor baked from that exact mesh (same seed / scale / yaw / instance colour; bake has no lean, sway, tint or wear), dithered cross-fades (trees 120-150 m, shrubs 55-75 m, impostors out to 1.3 km), shadow pass fades with the view camera; palms keep the same crown at every LOD

items.name: Biomes: Keys scrub, Keys sand, pine rockland, hammock, rural verge, glades (cypress domes), marsh, mangrove shore; 9 tree kinds x 2-3 seeds, seagrape / saw palmetto / fern shrubs; grove / clearing noise; per-instance hue

Ground cover: real thin grass blades (2 layers, 60 m and 32 m), daisies, tickseed, grey rocks, shoulder pebbles, on the terrain normal; haystack cones and flat palmetto cards gone from the countryside

Clearance: game.vegetation.field() drops plants on roads (edge width + 1.5 m), any deck / ramp footprint, sidewalk, pier, building surface; streamer skips decks and house lots (filtered in place when houses are planned later)
